text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Mayano Top Gun
and Oguri Cap at the track.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... —Phew.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Oguri-san~!
Here, this is for you♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: This is... yakisoba bread. Why give this to me?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You see~, it's a 'just-because present'
from Maya to you, Oguri-san♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Eat that and take a break, Oguri-san!
You copy?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*rummmble*)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah... my stomach...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mayano, you are incredible.
Thank you, I will gladly partake right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a rather curious exchange.
Intrigued, I couldn't help but keep watching Mayano Top Gun—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh? You look like you wanna ask something~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, from earlier? Because Oguri-san
had that super serious look on her face, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So Maya just "knew." But since I didn't
know what actually happened~

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I asked the people around her.
And then, get this――

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I see~. When my times won't improve,
Maya might get impatient too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has times when they want to push hard~.
I think we should just watch over her so she doesn't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So, I tried copying what my Papa used to do for me.
And that was――
choice_data_list: Was that what the present was earlier?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yep! You see, Maya's Papa is super busy,
but whenever I was feeling down, he always
"understood."

text_block_list.name: Mayano's Father
text_block_list.text:
Here, go ahead and open it, Maya.
From Papa to his cute little Maya who always tries her best――

text_block_list.name: Mayano's Father
text_block_list.text: It's an "un-special day present."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
What's inside is, like, snacks or stationery,
not really anything super special, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But just thinking about how Papa thought of Maya
made me forget all my worries right away!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's why! Maya wanted to give Oguri-san
a present to cheer her up too!
――That's what I thought!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Besides, giving a present on an un-special day
makes me feel like a mature woman, right~?
choice_data_list: He sounds like a wonderful dad.
Being able to care for someone is really "mature."
Caring for others is what makes you a real "grown-up."
Then should I give you something too?
How about I give you something as well?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Besides, giving a present on an un-special day
makes me feel like a mature woman, right~?
choice_data_list: He sounds like a wonderful dad.
Being able to care for someone is really "mature."
Caring for others is what makes you a real "grown-up."
Then should I give you something too?
How about I give you something as well?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Right, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I text with Papa a lot on LANE, and even now
he still gives me "un-special day presents."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: For example――here, look!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
This is a fancy cafe at his flight destination, right?
And then pretty scenery, and kitties too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
For Maya, more than receiving something, it's knowing
that Papa is thinking of Maya that makes me happy♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her accept the affection of others so purely and directly
left quite a strong impression.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I wonder where we should go next time I see Papa~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You know, sometimes on days when Papa doesn't have a flight,
the two of us go on dates!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
We go shopping~, go to cafes~.
...Oh, I know!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If you know any wonderful places I could go with Papa,
I'd love for you to tell me♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ideally somewhere mature~ and exciting,
and cute but with a sexy vibe!
choice_data_list: Isn't that a bit tough to find?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun's demanding question
left me scratching my head.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, isn't it! Maya's already totally
giving off "mature woman" vibes♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are☆ Mayano~, yoo-hoo★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh, it's Mave-chin! Yoo-hoo!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, we need to head to the cafe right now☆
The Rainbow Whipped Pudding is giving off
a totally marvelous feeling★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, a new menu item, yay~! A mature woman's
gotta jump on the trends right away♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Mayano Top Gun dashed off.
Looking at her from behind, she still seemed as innocently childish as her age suggested.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Remembering that I happened to have something good in my pocket,
I let her know.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh~, why why? Maya didn't do anything,
are you sure it's okay?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, copycat♪
Yay~, what are you gonna give me, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waah~, a lollipop! Maya loves these!
Thank you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~, now Maya got cheered up too♪
